title: Seminar in Research Problems; The Art of Interviewing
description: Prerequisite: This course will substantially deepen your skills at the most elemental act in journalism knowing how to ask questions that elicit more honest and illuminating answers. You'll learn by doing, watching, and listening-- looking at some of the best interviews ever --and some of the not so best --and analyze the differences. Students willconduct various interviews of their own, watch and critique themselves and their fellow students, and hear from some of the most skilled interviewers in the field today.
